title: ANAVO Pakistan energy context dataset
disclaimer: Compiled from public reporting and regulator documents. These are published figures and typed estimates, not measurements collected by the ANAVO team. Values marked basis=estimate are typical nameplate assumptions and remain editable in the app.

nepra_ke_feeders.title: NEPRA orders K-Electric to end load-shedding (Express Tribune)
nepra_ke_feeders.used_for: Average daily outage on high-loss (10 h 39 min) and very-high-loss (12 h 14 min) K-Electric feeders

nepra_qesco_notice.title: NEPRA show-cause notice to QESCO, loss-based load-shedding bands (2024)
nepra_qesco_notice.used_for: Scheduled load-shedding from 0 hours (low-loss feeders) up to 16 hours (feeders above 80% losses)

thenews_feeders.title: More than 2,000 feeders face over 10 hours of daily loadshedding, NA told (The News)
thenews_feeders.used_for: Scale of feeders with 10+ hours of daily outage

neeca_fans.title: Pakistani reporting on NEECA ceiling-fan efficiency standards (ProPakistani; ARY News)
neeca_fans.used_for: Conventional fans about 80-130 W; NEECA 3-star fans about 50-65 W; marketed inverter fans about 30 W (claims vary)

esmap_solar.title: Tahir & Asim, Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews 81 (2018) 2839-2861, citing World Bank ESMAP mapping
esmap_solar.used_for: Annual mean daily global horizontal irradiation of about 5.67 kWh/m2 (ESMAP estimate)

outage_profiles.label: Low-loss feeder
outage_profiles.note: Lowest loss band: no scheduled load-shedding; unscheduled faults still occur.

outage_profiles.label: High-loss feeder (Karachi average)
outage_profiles.note: 10 h 39 min average reported by NEPRA.

outage_profiles.label: Very-high-loss feeder (Karachi average)
outage_profiles.note: 12 h 14 min average reported by NEPRA.

outage_profiles.label: Highest loss band (>80% losses)
outage_profiles.note: Upper scheduled band; reports describe some areas exceeding it.

solar.note: Daily yield per kWp is approximated as GHI x performance ratio (about 4.25 kWh/kWp/day). Seasonal and city variation is not modeled.
